plan.title: PR-7 Assignee Visibility for Category-Level Item

steps.note: Open Purchase Requisitions as the PR manager.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-7 can be selected.

args.goal: Search for PR-7, select its FOOD STORE line item with no subcategory, click Assign next to Upload PRs, type User B (Fruits Buyer) into the Search a user box, and verify User B is not listed while User A (Food Buyer) is listed

steps.note: Perform and observe the assignment-user search flow that has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that the category-level Food Buyer is listed in the assignee results.
